column3: “Oracle” is rendered “burden,” and “on” “concerning”; NASB adds “Thus” and renders the participles as present.
“A basin of reeling” is rendered “a cup that causes reeling”; NASB restructures the second clause as “when the siege is against Jerusalem, it will also be against Judah.”
“A stone of burden” is rendered “a heavy stone”; “carry” is rendered “lift,” and “gather on it” “be gathered against it.”
“Open my eyes over” is rendered “watch over”; NASB adds “But” and “while.”
“Chiefs” is rendered “clans”; “strength to me” is rendered “A strong support for us.”
“Chiefs” is rendered “clans,” and “cut grain” “sheaves”; “Jerusalem will remain” is rendered “the inhabitants of Jerusalem again dwell.”
“The one who stumbles” is rendered “the one who is feeble.”
“A spirit of favor and supplications” is rendered “the Spirit of grace and of supplication”; NASB supplies “Him,” and renders “show bitterness” as “weep bitterly.”
“Clans, clans, alone” is rendered “every family by itself.”
